_comment: Helper config for the RSFQ test-bench tools. Design-derived values (clock frequency, PTL delay, core pitch, die size, I/O nets) are exported by the app to die.tb.json next to die.cir; anything set here overrides or supplements them. Run the tools from this directory (or pass --config).
_comment2: Stimulus knobs. clockPeriodPs <= 0 means derive it from freqGHz in die.tb.json (period = 1000/freqGHz). useInputWindow uses the exporter's inputWindowTarget* bounds; startupPeriods skips extra clock edges (0 now that the PTL block delay matches the exporter; raise it if a future library needs startup settling). settlePs is the earliest absolute launch time; the earlier of clock/data starts there. inputWindowMode is start|center|end|positive (end avoids the too-early edge of the derived window). dataPhasePs is only the fallback when inputWindowFound is false. pipelineLevels is the max clock depth; outputWatchStart = clockSend + (pipelineLevels-1)*period + minOutputTravelPs (the travel figure already includes the final level trigger). decodeWindowStartPs equals outputWatchStartPs by default; decodeStartPeriods shifts it by whole clock periods if a die's first usable output window is earlier/later. pipelineLatencySlots is the older fallback. timeStepPs/josimMaxRows keep JoSIM's time-point memory in check (measured: 80k points OK, 100k crashed on an 8 GB box).
